Date: 12 November 2024
Topic: Pharmacy – Investigational Product (IP) Accountability and Temperature Excursion Handling
Trainer: Pharmacy Manager, Daniel Koh
Duration: 1000 – 1130
Attendees: Nurul Huda, Rachel Tan, Kelvin Chua
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: Logging of IP dispensation and return, temperature monitoring device calibration checks, and the procedure for temperature excursion beyond 2–8°C. Review of the excursion report form and escalation pathway to the sponsor within 24 hours.

Competency assessment: Practical drill – simulated temperature excursion. Attendees completed the excursion form and notified the sponsor contact (simulated) within the required timeframe. All correct.

Remarks: Attendance signed. This training satisfies the annual pharmacy training requirement for research coordinators.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
ENTRY 008
Date: 19 November 2024
Topic: Data Entry and Query Resolution – EDC System (Medidata Rave) Updates
Trainer: Rachel Tan (Senior Data Coordinator)
Duration: 1400 – 1600
Attendees: Nurul Huda, Meera Nair, Jun Wei
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: Recent system update to the eCRF layout for the oncology study. Changes to the adverse event log and concomitant medication pages. Query resolution workflow, including timelines for response (5 business days). Demonstration of the new auto-query feature for missing fields.

Competency assessment: Hands-on session. Each attendee entered test data into the training environment and resolved three mock queries. All resolved correctly.

Remarks: Attendance signed. Rachel Tan noted that this was an internal session to align with the sponsor's system release notes.
ENTRY 009
Date: 26 November 2024
Topic: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Refresher – Informed Consent Process and Documentation
Trainer: Dr. Priya Raman (Principal Investigator)
Duration: 0900 – 1200
Attendees: Nurul Huda, Rachel Tan, Kelvin Chua, Meera Nair, Jun Wei, Daniel Koh (partial attendance)
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: Review of the ICH GCP E6(R2) requirements for informed consent, including the use of the latest approved consent form version (v4.0 dated 02 October 2024) for the oncology study. Discussion on the process for re-consenting subjects when new safety information becomes available. Emphasis on documenting the consent discussion in the source notes, including the date and time of consent, the version of the consent form used, and the name of the person who conducted the discussion.

Competency assessment: Written quiz (10 questions) administered at the end of the session. All attendees scored 80% or above. Nurul Huda scored 100%. Quiz results filed in each attendee's training file.

Remarks: Dr. Raman noted that this refresher is required annually for all staff involved in the consent process. Daniel Koh attended the first hour only, as he was called to the pharmacy for an urgent IP query. His quiz was completed separately on 27 November 2024 and scored 90%. Attendance sheet signed by all attendees and co-signed by Dr. Raman.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
ENTRY 010
Date: 03 December 2024
Topic: Serious Adverse Event (SAE) Reporting – Updated Sponsor Requirements
Trainer: Rachel Tan (Senior Data Coordinator), with Dr. Priya Raman as co-facilitator
Duration: 1400 – 1530
Attendees: Nurul Huda, Kelvin Chua, Meera Nair
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: The sponsor issued a revised SAE reporting guideline effective 01 December 2024. Key changes include: (1) the initial SAE report to the sponsor must be submitted within 24 hours of site awareness, (2) the follow-up report must include the causality assessment by the investigator, and (3) the SAE form must be signed by the investigator before submission. Review of the updated SAE form fields, including the new field for "Time of Site Awareness" in 24-hour format.

Competency assessment: Case-based discussion. Attendees were given a mock SAE scenario and asked to complete the updated SAE form. All attendees correctly identified the reporting timeframe and completed the form without missing fields. Kelvin Chua initially omitted the time of site awareness field but corrected it after review.

Remarks: Attendance signed. Dr. Raman reminded attendees that the updated guideline supersedes the previous version dated 15 March 2024. A copy of the revised guideline was distributed to all attendees and filed in the study master file.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
ENTRY 011
Date: 10 December 2024
Topic: Specimen Handling and Shipping – Dry Ice and Temperature Monitoring
Trainer: Nurul Huda (Senior Research Coordinator), with external trainer Ms. Lim Siew Mei (Logistics Coordinator, World Courier)
Duration: 1000 – 1200
Attendees: Rachel Tan, Meera Nair, Jun Wei
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: Proper packing of specimens for shipping, including the use of dry ice and the required amount per container. Handling of temperature monitoring devices and interpretation of temperature data loggers. Review of the shipping checklist, including the completion of the Dangerous Goods Declaration and the airway bill. Ms. Lim demonstrated the use of the World Courier online booking system and the process for tracking shipments.

Competency assessment: Practical demonstration. Each attendee packed a mock specimen box with dry ice and a temperature logger, and completed the shipping checklist. All boxes were inspected by Ms. Lim and passed inspection. Temperature logger data was reviewed and recorded.

Remarks: Attendance signed by all attendees and co-signed by Ms. Lim. This session was arranged as an annual refresher for specimen shipping. Jun Wei was noted to require additional practice on the online booking system; a follow-up session was scheduled for 17 December 2024.

ENTRY 009
Date: 26 November 2024
Topic: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Refresher – Informed Consent Process and Documentation
Trainer: Dr. Priya Raman (Principal Investigator)
Duration: 0900 – 1200
Attendees: Nurul Huda, Rachel Tan, Kelvin Chua, Meera Nair, Jun Wei, Daniel Koh (partial attendance)
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: Review of the ICH GCP E6(R2) requirements for informed consent, including the use of the latest approved consent form version (v4.0 dated 02 October 2024) for the oncology study. Discussion on the process for re-consenting subjects when new safety information becomes available. Emphasis on documenting the consent discussion in the source notes, including the date and time of consent, the version of the consent form used, and the name of the person who conducted the discussion.

Competency assessment: Written quiz (10 questions) administered at the end of the session. All attendees scored 80% or above. Nurul Huda scored 100%. Quiz results filed in each attendee's training file.

Remarks: Dr. Raman noted that this refresher is required annually for all staff involved in the consent process. Daniel Koh attended the first hour only, as he was called to the pharmacy for an urgent IP query. His quiz was completed separately on 27 November 2024 and scored 90%. Attendance sheet signed by all attendees and co-signed by Dr. Raman.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
ENTRY 010
Date: 03 December 2024
Topic: Serious Adverse Event (SAE) Reporting – Updated Sponsor Requirements
Trainer: Rachel Tan (Senior Data Coordinator), with Dr. Priya Raman as co-facilitator
Duration: 1400 – 1530
Attendees: Nurul Huda, Kelvin Chua, Meera Nair
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: The sponsor issued a revised SAE reporting guideline effective 01 December 2024. Key changes include: (1) the initial SAE report to the sponsor must be submitted within 24 hours of site awareness, (2) the follow-up report must include the causality assessment by the investigator, and (3) the SAE form must be signed by the investigator before submission. Review of the updated SAE form fields, including the new field for "Time of Site Awareness" in 24-hour format.

Competency assessment: Case-based discussion. Attendees were given a mock SAE scenario and asked to complete the updated SAE form. All attendees correctly identified the reporting timeframe and completed the form without missing fields. Kelvin Chua initially omitted the time of site awareness field but corrected it after review.

Remarks: Attendance signed. Dr. Raman reminded attendees that the updated guideline supersedes the previous version dated 15 March 2024. A copy of the revised guideline was distributed to all attendees and filed in the study master file.

ENTRY 011
Date: 10 December 2024
Topic: Specimen Handling and Shipping – Dry Ice and Temperature Monitoring
Trainer: Nurul Huda (Senior Research Coordinator), with external trainer Ms. Lim Siew Mei (Logistics Coordinator, World Courier)
Duration: 1000 – 1200
Attendees: Rachel Tan, Meera Nair, Jun Wei
Status: Historical – Closed

Content covered: Proper packing of specimens for shipping, including the use of dry ice and the required amount per container. Handling of temperature monitoring devices and interpretation of temperature data loggers. Review of the shipping checklist, including the completion of the Dangerous Goods Declaration and the airway bill. Ms. Lim demonstrated the use of the World Courier online booking system and the process for tracking shipments.

Competency assessment: Practical demonstration. Each attendee packed a mock specimen box with dry ice and a temperature logger, and completed the shipping checklist. All boxes were inspected by Ms. Lim and passed inspection. Temperature logger data was reviewed and recorded.

Remarks: Attendance signed by all attendees and co-signed by Ms. Lim. This session was arranged as an annual refresher for specimen shipping. Jun Wei was noted to require additional practice on the online booking system; a follow-up session was scheduled for 17 December 2024.
